topic: Keeping old credit cards open for credit age vs closing them (Rowan vs Juno)

scenes.narration: Closing one old card aged a credit history backward and dropped the score. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at a calendar timeline, comic burst banner reads CREDIT AGE CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan and Juno each own a ten year old credit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man rowan and woman juno each holding a card stamped TEN YEARS OLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Credit age measures how long your accounts have stayed open.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a chart of a timeline labeled AVERAGE CREDIT AGE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan closes his oldest card because he barely uses it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rowan cutting an old credit card, a folder stamped ACCOUNT CLOSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That closure erases ten years from his average account age.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a timeline shrinking, a meter labeled CREDIT AGE dropping fast, worried man rowan watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Juno keeps her oldest card open and never closes it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman juno tucking an old card into a drawer labeled KEEP OPEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She makes one tiny purchase yearly to keep it active.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman juno buying a coffee with the old card, a calendar marked ONCE A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan's average age falls and his score drops thirty points.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit score gauge dropping THIRTY POINTS into the yellow zone, glum man rowan watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Juno's long history keeps her score steady and strong.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit score gauge holding steady in the green zone, smiling woman juno beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rowan waits years for his credit age to recover.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rowan staring at a slow timeline labeled REBUILDING, an hourglass beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Juno's old card quietly boosts every loan application she makes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman juno handing over a loan form stamped APPROVED, a long history chart behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Keep old cards open and make tiny charges to stay active. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading KEEP OLD CARDS OPEN, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
